question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing fullback, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing right midfielder, Fred is playing cheerleader, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Finally, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) fullback
(C) sweeper
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right midfielder
(F) cheerleader
(G) right winger
solution:
Each tuple lists positions in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (right back, fullback, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, cheerleader, right winger)
1. Alice swaps with Fred: (cheerleader, fullback, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, right back, right winger)
2. Bob swaps with Gertrude: (cheerleader, right winger, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, right back, fullback)
3. Gertrude swaps with Dave: (cheerleader, right winger, sweeper, fullback, right midfielder, right back, benchwarmer)
4. Dave swaps with Gertrude: (cheerleader, right winger, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, right back, fullback)
5. Alice swaps with Fred: (right back, right winger, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, cheerleader, fullback)
6. Alice swaps with Bob: (right winger, right back, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, cheerleader, fullback)
7. Gertrude swaps with Fred: (right winger, right back, sweeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, fullback, cheerleader)
Dave is the benchwarmer, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
